primary_observational_inference.estimator: full-sample five-tracer luminosity-rank conservative nuisance-projected DESI DR1 dipole fit
primary_observational_inference.single_sentence_rationale: This is the sole headline observational coefficient because the direct real-data analysis was fixed before later mock-covariance and orthogonal-control closure; Gfinder, EZmock, Abacus and ell=3 are validation/control layers rather than alternative headline estimates.

ell3_octupole_control.condition_number_definition: cond(C_reg), where C_reg = C_JK + r I and r = max(1e-7 lambda_max(C_JK), 1e-6 median(diag(C_JK)), 1e-14); this is not the raw covariance condition number.

abacus_documentation_resolution.old_state: 24/25 was an earlier pre-closure documentation state while mock 11 was in a transport-only retry.
abacus_documentation_resolution.final_state: 25/25 PASS; workflow run 34780454743 completed successfully and the final aggregate is frozen.

blinding.statement: Real-data outputs were inspected during pipeline development. Final tracer definitions, separation/redshift bins, nuisance model, production seed and independent closure seeds were fixed before the final closure tests.

provenance_guardrails: There is exactly one publication-facing headline observational coefficient: the full-sample luminosity-rank conservative DESI dipole fit.
Gfinder, EZmock, Abacus and ell=3 are validation/control layers, not alternative headline estimates.
The ell=3 condition number 440.8145 refers to the ridge-regularized jackknife covariance used for inversion, not the raw covariance.
Final Abacus status is 25/25 PASS; any 24/25 wording is stale pre-closure documentation preserved only in Git history.
No observational result is presented as a neutrino-wake detection.
